rawIntent: Angular, Asp.Net core Webapi with CQRS pattern, SQL Lite database

layers: PharmAPI.Api (Presentation / Web API Controllers / Swagger OpenAPI)
PharmAPI.Application (CQRS Commands, Queries, Handlers, Behaviors, DTOs, Interfaces)
PharmAPI.Domain (Entities, Value Objects, Domain Exceptions, Enums)
PharmAPI.Infrastructure (Persistence, EF Core DbContext, SQLite Repositories, Identity)

implementationPolicy.apiDesign: RESTful HTTP JSON endpoints with standard status codes and Swagger annotations
implementationPolicy.cqrs: Segregation of Commands (mutations) and Queries (read-only) via MediatR
implementationPolicy.solid: Clean Architecture concentric boundaries with inverted dependencies
implementationPolicy.cleanCode: Asynchronous I/O, domain rule encapsulation, structured error handling
